dog.description_text:
💙 ASHER
🐶 Male | 9–10 weeks old (currently) | 7.5 lbs.

Don't let that little body fool you—Asher has BIG personality! 😂

Asher's story started when a Good Samaritan found him all alone under a house. At approximately 6 weeks old, he weighed just 2.2 lbs. Since then, this little guy has been making up for lost time and is now growing like a weed!

We honestly have no clue what breed Asher is, but he definitely has some serious "little dog" attitude. 😂
